question: What cycle life (number of cycles to 80% capacity) does the review report for the oxyfluoride Li2Mn2/3Nb1/3O2F?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE (lower(text) LIKE '%nb1/3%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%nb%o2f%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%oxyfluoride%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%80%capacity%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%80%') AND page >= 8 AND page <= 13 ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE page IN (9,10,11) AND kind IN ('line','lines') ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE page IN (9,10,11,12) AND (lower(text) LIKE '%cycle%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%retention%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%fluor%') ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE page IN (11,12) AND kind IN ('line') ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE page IN (7,8) AND kind='line' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM atoms WHERE page IN (7,8)) AND (text LIKE '%cycl%' OR text LIKE '%retention%' OR text LIKE '%80%' OR text LIKE '%DRX%' OR text LIKE '%Nb%') ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%cycles%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%cycle life%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%80%capacity%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%capacity retention%' OR text LIKE '%80\%%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY page, id
